project.name: polliwog
project.one_line: one squeeze/swell interface over zlib, zstd, and lz4. errors are values. caller owns memory.
project.theme: wetland / pond life; sibling of the tadpole project
project.org_role: compression package of the wetland ecosystem
project.naming_governance: packages are pond life, versions are growth stages, the org is the water

components.brood: parallel batch engine; deterministic merge across a thread pool
components.pond: test corpus: silesia, enwik, synthetic structured data

zlib_ng.role: optional drop-in fast fork, symbol-mangled, off by default

zstd.role: modern default for new data; dictionaries later

lz4.role: speed floor backend; frame + block formats

toolchain.fuzzing: libFuzzer + AFL++ smoke corpus in CI
toolchain.formatting: clang-format owns layout; clang-tidy for smell
toolchain.warning_policy: warning-free is a hard gate on our code

versioning.scheme: CalVer YYYY.N.P; ecosystem packages pin by milestone, never by patch

milestones.name: spawn
milestones.scope: bootstrap: docs, ci, templates, backend contract, no public code

milestones.name: hatch
milestones.scope: zlib backend mvp: one-shot + streaming squeeze/swell, tests, benchmarks

milestones.name: tadpole
milestones.scope: zstd backend, error taxonomy frozen, fuzzing wired

milestones.name: froglet
milestones.scope: brood batch engine, mmap input, zlib-ng option, lz4 backend

milestones.name: frog
milestones.scope: vcpkg/conan packaging, docs site, abi freeze, lz4 promoted

non_goals: archive formats (zip, tar) - that is frogspawn's job, someday, maybe
network or disk io in core
plugin systems, dependency injection, service locators
